description: Register the coordinator and the configured workers.
rationale: citus_ensure_workers names no host: the addresses come from citus.workers in this connection's section of the configuration, which run.sh writes. Bounded here because that file is unsigned and a worker receives shards of the data. unlisted=refuse, because a cluster that does not match what was configured should stop the run rather than be quietly corrected. The coordinator takes no shards: it routes, the workers hold the data.

intents.comment: How the workers reach the coordinator.
The coordinator routes; the workers hold the shards.
The workers are whatever this connection's citus.workers says they are.
